title: CF-NODE: Counterfactual Spatial Node Intervention for Test-Time Adaptation Under Domain Shift, Evaluated Across Five Diabetic Retinopathy Datasets
abstract: arXiv:2610.22437v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated fundus-based diabetic retinopathy (DR) grading can substantially expand screening capacity, but source-trained models degrade sharply across different cameras, clinics, and patient populations. Existing test-time adaptation methods depend on entropy minimization or target information accumulated from image batches and streams. These mechanisms can reinforce confidently incorrect predictions and break down when clinical images arrive independently. We introduce CF-NODE, a novel counterfactual test-time adaptation framework for cross- domain DR grading. Instead of trusting prediction confidence or estimating a target distribution, CF-NODE asks how each prediction responds under a controlled intervention on the evidence supporting it. CF-NODE ranks internal spatial nodes using model-derived attention, feature magnitude, and node-set similarity, progressively attenuates the highest-ranked nodes, and uses the stability of the result

translated_title: CF-NODE：面向领域偏移下测试时自适应的反事实空间节点干预方法，并在五个糖尿病视网膜病变数据集上进行评估
translated_abstract: 基于眼底图像的糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）自动分级可以大幅扩展筛查能力，但在不同的相机、诊所和患者人群中，源域训练的模型性能会急剧下降。现有的测试时自适应方法依赖于熵最小化，或依赖于从图像批次和数据流中积累的目标域信息。这些机制可能会强化那些自信但错误的预测，并且在临床图像独立到达时会失效。我们提出了CF-NODE，一个用于跨域DR分级的新型反事实测试时自适应框架。CF-NODE不依赖预测置信度，也不估计目标分布，而是探究每个预测在对支持它的证据进行受控干预后如何响应。CF-NODE利用模型导出的注意力、特征幅值和节点集相似度对内部空间节点进行排序，逐步衰减排名最高的节点，并利用结果的稳定性……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出CF-NODE反事实测试时自适应框架，通过对空间节点的受控干预评估预测稳定性，从而在五个糖尿病视网膜病变数据集上提升跨域分级的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: CF-NODE introduces a counterfactual test-time adaptation framework that intervenes on spatial nodes to assess prediction stability, improving robustness of cross-domain diabetic retinopathy grading across five datasets.
